milestones.description: Uses position_near_with_facing because this is a find/locate task. The player must navigate near the orange stained glass panes on the west wall (centered at spawn-relative 4, 2, 7) and face toward them. max_distance=16 allows detection from a reasonable viewing distance, and facing_tolerance=60 ensures the player is actually looking at the panes.

Uses position_near_with_facing because this is a find/locate task. The player must navigate near the cobwebs on the ceiling inside the structure (centered at spawn-relative 7, 3, 7) and face toward them. max_distance=10 requires the player to be inside or near the structure entrance, and facing_tolerance=60 ensures they are looking up toward the ceiling cobwebs.

Uses count_in_box_at_most (kind=block, max_count=2) because mining a red stained glass pane means at least one of the 3 placed panes has been broken. We check that the box containing all 3 red panes now has at most 2 remaining, confirming at least one was mined. The box is generous (±2 around the pane locations on the east wall).

Uses inventory_has because crafting red dye from poppy results in the red_dye item appearing in the player's inventory. The player starts with 0 red_dye, so having at least 1 confirms successful crafting.
